name: 10468 · Bronx, NY
findings: ZIP 10468 (Bronx) has 124 nonprofit organizations. 48 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10468 (Bronx) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few religious organizations list membership
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 14 would.
